labs.lab_name: Bloomberg Center for Cities at Harvard University
labs.pi_title: Director; Emma Bloomberg Senior Lecturer in Public Policy and Management
labs.research_summary: Cross-Harvard center, founded in 2021 with Bloomberg Philanthropies, for research, executive education and tools on city leadership and governance.
labs.join_notes: Jobs page lists open staff posts (Senior Director of City Talent and Student Career Pathways; Postdoctoral Research Fellow, Local Politics Lab) and says Harvard students can apply for Spring 2027 research assistant jobs by November 23.
labs.notes: Member count left null: the staff page is a long roster mixing the center with its flagship labs, fellows and summer associates, and the faculty page lists many affiliates from across Harvard. Staff include Neel Chaudhury (Executive Director, Administration and Finance). A contact page is linked but was not read.

labs.join_notes: The lab is hiring a postdoctoral research fellow to start July 2027 (one-year term, renewable; $81,000; on campus at least three days a week); apply with CV, cover letter, writing sample and two references, due by November 22, 2026. The center's jobs page also lists Spring 2027 research assistant posts for enrolled Harvard students, and the lab page has an interest form.
